reuse.why: Every month-wide action uses the existing eligibility helper, and the new action reuses the amount-sign, date, batching, and undo abstractions.

duplication.why: The template-presence and fixed-group SQL expressions are repeated across six queries, including a copied category query in the new action.

placement.why: Budget selection and calculation remain in actions.ts, while method registration and undo wrapping follow app.ts conventions.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, and relevant tests.

maintainability.why: Shared filtering keeps callers consistent, but maintaining six copies of eligibility derivation makes future rule changes unnecessarily fragile.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions route category selection through getBudgetActionCategories and retain existing budget-write abstractions.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated eligibility SQL in actions.ts is copied directly rather than disguised through renaming or restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: getBudgetActionCategories retains its existing parameters and gains two general exclusions; callers use the existing hidden-category policy without introducing exceptions or bypasses.
